# Where to find and how to farm for Salt, Pepper, and Spices in Fallout 76: Toxic Valley

- Duchess Flame![Writer: Duchess Flame]()
- Aug 12, 2023
- 8 min read

Updated: Dec 17, 2023

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_ba285c97cfe54e6197a39d224aa5c58e~mv2.jpg)

MonaLisa gewidmet, vielen Dank für Ihre Liebe und Unterstützung. Mögen wir für immer Freunde von Google Translation sein.

There are two types of condiment spawns in Fallout 76.

One is a fixed spawn, for example, Pepper will always spawn at that location.

The other type of spawn is an "Any spawn". An "Any" spawn can be either Salt, Pepper, Sugar, or Spices.

I will note at each location if there are any "Any" spawns and how many there are at that location.

In the Toxic Valley, there are:

21x Any spawns

17x Salt spawns

21x Pepper spawns

13x Spices spawns

__Farming Tips and Tricks__

Salt and Pepper are a per server, pick-up history list item.

If you don't know what any of that means, you can find the guide __here__.

No perk cards or magazines affect the yield of Salt and Pepper. It is unfortunately a one-for-one farm.

Thru-Hiker Perk Card under Agility and the Grocery Backpack from the Settlers can reduce the weight of Salt and Pepper.

Avoid using explosive weapons as the condiments can move. If the condiments do move and you can't find them, fast travel out of the cell, the next map icon over is fine and then come back. The cell should have reset and the condiments will be back in their spawn locations.

__Fixed Spawn Locations__

I have used a mod on custom world to make the condiments easier to see in each photo.

**The Crosshair**

1x Any

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_592bbf351ede489ea43623ebc06de4c4~mv2.jpg)

Enter the Crosshair and head East towards the lookout tower. Under the lookout tower, on the metal barrel, next to the workbench.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_16e9792e328e49cc85cd7121aa59fa6e~mv2.jpg)

**Clancy Manor**

1x Pepper

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_0aa08d3432a34791a5fecf3c09cb1296~mv2.jpg)

Enter the Manor and head towards the kitchen. On the counter, near the stove.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_6623b06c309247b2b6ac2effe3c50e44~mv2.jpg)

**Hemlock Holes**

2x Salt

2x Pepper

1x Spices

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_a9fbd678bc614a59b6878e3b7431a904~mv2.jpg)

Check all the picnic tables in the carpark first, and then head inside the diner. Check the tables, the cafe counter, and on top of the fridge.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_90814b651bc2413b885c7ca9fa61ca90~mv2.jpg)

**Cobbleton Farm**

1x Pepper

1x Spices

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_19ddf793548e411388d102d1a726d8de~mv2.jpg)

Run up the hill towards the Cobbleton Farm map icon. Enter the house and look for the shelves that are on the SE wall. The spawns are on the bottom shelf.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_aef6a62b9cf24e94b357bd032567a1a7~mv2.jpg)

**Lady Janet's Soft Serve**

1x Salt

1x Pepper

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_f4a15e0463004ebaa41608ae559875db~mv2.jpg)

Check the picnic tables that are out the front and on the Northern side of the ruined trailer.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_751ec58e6af9429eaefdda99552c4fff~mv2.jpg)

**Becker Farm**

2x Any

1x Salt

1x Pepper

2x Spices

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_257f4ae17c4341989fc038c795a2038d~mv2.jpg)

Head West towards the two houses at the back. In the first house, check the shelves behind the couch and on top of the fridge.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_53285c23dfe24d4abd03aac701914773~mv2.jpg)

In the second house, check on the BBQ on the front porch and inside, next to the sink in the kitchen.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_65b1b071dfdb45a693da0a0f828cead7~mv2.jpg)

**Grafton Station**

1x Salt

1x Pepper

1x Spices

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_0a9c6e0abda04aa48016129c4258673e~mv2.jpg)

First spawn location: From the fast travel point, turn NE and follow the train tracks to the end. Jump on top of the train and face East. Run forward and stop in the carpark next to the yellow car. Turn and look for the blue brick building with the Nuka Cola machine out the front. Enter that building and turn right at the counter. Follow the stairs to the very top level and the spawns will be in the apartment, on the kitchen table.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_1f405bacb6eb4fc49207d51fdfd450a5~mv2.jpg)

Second spawn location: Go back downstairs and stand in the carpark, next to the yellow car. Turn North and left a little bit, until you are facing the large hill in the distance. Run straight forward until you get to the top of the hill. The spawns are behind and next to the bar.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_e646fd93b6844547bf78d644f0d9bbb5~mv2.jpg)

**Smith Farm**

1x Pepper

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_1bc8b3bf663d42fe9bf8d0cbccc7fb2e~mv2.jpg)

From the spawn in location, turn East and to the right a little bit. There should be a hill with a large metal pylon on the top, in the distance. Run forward until you get to the top of the hill. Under the pylon, inside the tent is the spawn.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_871967ddb05c46ad846ead3b9b897775~mv2.jpg)

**Eastern Regional Penitentiary**

Internal

You will need lock-pick and Hacker perk cards or the Master Infiltrator Legendary Perk Card to access some of these locations.

1x Any

1x Salt

1x Pepper

2x Spices

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_143a8c592b864584923d3cc48afa971d~mv2.jpg)

From the spawn in location, follow the road East. Keep following it all the way around to the back of the Prison and the loading dock. Stop when you get to the front of the red trailer and turn left, you should be in front of a blue metal door, next to a large metal garage door. Interact with the door "Eastern Regional Penitentiary - Storeroom" and load inside.

First spawn location:

From the door, turn SE and walk over to the open door. The spawn is on the kitchen counter against the Northern wall.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_31fd188dc6894e709149d1b2b2eb4c18~mv2.jpg)

Second spawn location:

Turn South, jump over the counter, and walk forward toward Cell Block B. On your left will be a metal ramp going up. Take the ramp to the top and then follow the catwalk South. Jump or jetpack over the gap in the catwalk and keep going South. Open the door, walk straight, and follow the room around. Open the next door and keep walking straight until you get to the end of the broken catwalk. Drop down to the ground and keep heading West. Look for a cooking station and a guard post on your right. The spawns are on the small table, next to the cooking station.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_1cb1b4f0b62942a589ac82893cb5dc5e~mv2.jpg)

Third spawn location:

Face West and walk towards the doorway marked "Entrance". Walk through the doorway and keep walking West until you see a door marked "Intake" on your left.

Unlock the level three terminal next to the door and enter the room. Use the button on the wall on your right to open the door marked "Infirmary". Enter that room and walk over to the blue metal door with "Cell Block D" on the sign above it.

Open the door and follow the corridor around until you get to an orange cart on your left. Open the cell door that is next to the orange cart, and walk through the holes in the walls until you get to the other side. You should be facing three red metal benches.

Walk straight and veer right, until you are standing in front of the blue-painted piece of wood leaning against the cells on the other side of the room. Enter the cell door on your right, walk through the hole in the wall, and out to the corridor on the other side. Turn left and look for the cooking station on your right. The spawns are on the edge of the cooking station and on the edge of the sink.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_08156b62a18948a79b4386c89308c202~mv2.jpg)

**Grafton Dam**

2x Any

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_0799ddcf519a4ea48420e7ffdc8638c6~mv2.jpg)

At Grafton Dam, out the front of the shed, on the right-hand side, next to the cooking station, on top of a metal crate.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_d5e851fe849e4e2989a80c66db1010c8~mv2.jpg)

**Grafton Steel**

1x Spices

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_1d3c62e22ec0429a8e9721346b689fc5~mv2.jpg)

From the spawn-in point, turn West and run straight forward, until you get to the pipes hanging over the edge of the dam. Follow the pipe on the right to the end, turn right, and then jump down to the ground. The spawn is in the camp, at the base of the wall.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_a488b853972c4feda095fec10c601d0a~mv2.jpg)

**Pioneer Scout Camp**

1x Any

1x Salt

1x Pepper

1x Spices

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_c2c49a5c2a8446d99957f0b59a5c546b~mv2.jpg)

From the fast travel point, turn South and follow the path. Keep to the top of the path (SW) and keep walking forward until you get to the mess hall. Inside the mess hall, in the kitchen, on the counters against the South wall. There is also a spawn on the stairs by the back door.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_ced678f70f194b52a8e4f37066db5369~mv2.jpg)

**Clarksburg Shooting Club**

2x Any

2x Salt

2x Spices

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_f3a3375ba10e40ca9d9771059a2bdf50~mv2.jpg)

First spawn location: From the fast travel point, face North and run over to the building with the green roof. Enter the building and the spawns are on the counter, next to the sink, against the Northern wall.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_9d40e64292ff4787814fb15d3157bda8~mv2.jpg)

Second spawn location: Exit the building, face South, and walk over to the main road. Turn East and follow the road until you see the ruined houses on your left. Turn and walk over to the first house and the spawn is on the back patio table.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_45e5f76cc64141b1ab1185072e87956b~mv2.jpg)

Walk over to the second ruined house and another spawn is on the edge of the bathtub, on the ground floor.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_d3b82b5e5fa3424cbd80fd9360619c8f~mv2.jpg)

Head over to the third house. On the ground floor, there is one spawn on top of the stove and another in the cabinet next to the stairs.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_ec34e9de43c447c3b478e161b208ce88~mv2.jpg)

**Graninger Farm**

1x Salt

1x Pepper

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_d59a4478666a4d3ba1d303027f48cb21~mv2.jpg)

From the spawn-in location, turn SW and run forward until you get to a carpark with a camper trailer parked in the left corner. In the carpark, turn East and walk over to the camper trailer. The spawn is inside the trailer, on the bench, next to the sink.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_52d2d53c3565478c9b8d301fb8607d7a~mv2.jpg)

**Toxic Dried Lakebed**

4x Salt

4x Pepper

1x Spices

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_08ecc20bbe5b4c97b0cfa39d71f5f071~mv2.jpg)

First spawn location: From the fast travel point, follow the road and stop at the first ruined building on your right. Enter the building and there are three spawns on the counter, against the SE wall.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_c5ab76c6d0a34e958f577c120e6bf232~mv2.jpg)

Second spawn location: Turn around and walk over to the diner (next building over). I would lure the ghouls out first and dispose of them and then come back and loot, otherwise, the condiments will go flying.

There are multiple spawns in this building. Check the diner tables and behind and on top of the counters. Walk around to the serving window on the outside of the diner and check the counters for more spawns.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_8990b56797654ec4be0acfee395752a9~mv2.jpg)

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_0ade4192b2de4b6f8a88682b5e574f1d~mv2.jpg)

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_750aa140ebc143e09f6cb75464e42630~mv2.jpg)

**Kiddie Corner**

4x Any

1x Salt

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_28084fa09e8f4546b282fdee99c6c51a~mv2.jpg)

First spawn location: From the spawn-in location, walk forward and enter the first cabin on your left. Check the counter next to the sink, the overhead cupboards in the kitchen, and the dining room table.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_f2c32f6517e84388af270afbeed586f0~mv2.jpg)

Second spawn location: Inside the second cabin on your left, check the table and the small cabinet against the SW wall.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_bb652cc59f8743c895ece646911146c8~mv2.jpg)

**Willard Corporate Housing**

4x Any

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_4fc3baf415e44529be8e7dbd34222866~mv2.jpg)

First spawn location: I would lure the floaters away from the area first and dispose of them and then come back to loot as they can knock and move the spawns.

In the middle of the housing area, next to the cooking station, on the edge of the brick cooking pit.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_b5ac960abbd548b2aa2cd167ebb5ff42~mv2.jpg)

Second spawn location:

From the cooking pit, turn NE and walk over to the ruined trailer in the distance. The spawns are on the counter, inside the trailer.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_0a010fb5d12d4315ac9b5367584c8d69~mv2.jpg)

**The Crater**

2x Any

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_779f37bb5cee42abaa68409a96a3dc90~mv2.jpg)

From the fast travel point, turn SE and run forward until you get to the very top of the hill in front of you. At the top of the hill is a Raider Lookout Tower. The spawns are inside the tower, on the shelf, next to the bed.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_8bd0aa297e7b41fe99d9d32ac3adc60c~mv2.jpg)

**Philippi Battlefield Cemetery**

1x Any

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_db809cd138c6436db1a23d6e9a1e2950~mv2.jpg)

Inside the building, on the ground floor, under the counter.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_7bf39754306a4130a6837d27cd61ccc8~mv2.jpg)

**Knife Edge**

4x Pepper

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_d7507ea8b0284af487f24b3d7fc0c24d~mv2.jpg)

From the spawn-in location, head over to the Raider Lookout Tower. At the top of the tower, on the table is a spawn. Behind the Lookout Tower, on the table, next to the radio is another spawn. Check the tents on the Western side of the Lookout Tower, there are two more spawns, next to the brick fire pit.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_9cc6583f4c0742fda0f2e86fb7cedf57~mv2.jpg)

**Prickett's Fort**

1x Any

2x Salt

2x Pepper

2x Spices

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_fc982e7a5afe4533aebaa85cdda1bbce~mv2.jpg)

First spawn location: From the fast travel point, run all the way up the back to the cabins. Most of the cabins are numbered.

Look for and stop at cabin number four. Face North and there should be a small cabin with a white chimney to your left. Walk over and enter that cabin and the spawn is on top of the chest of drawers, near the door.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_608bdf4b49114e1cabf9c365b21b2daf~mv2.jpg)

Turn around and walk back to cabin number four. At the back of cabin number four is a cooking station and some wooden crates. The spawn is on the wooden crates, to the right of the cooking station.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_15bb1dfeb7c5414cba6c17f74e0f628d~mv2.jpg)

Second spawn location: From the cooking station, turn North and walk forward, through the gap in the fence. Keep walking straight North, down the hill until you see some port-a-potties on your left. The spawn is on the right of the port-a-potties, inside the small building, on the counter.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_1081a2aab5eb4ec88150a87c1c0c7030~mv2.jpg)
